tools.name: search_campers
tools.description: Search active camper listings on VanAuto (vanauto.pl). Use segment "sale" for campers for sale and "rental" for camper rentals. Returns compact rows with price, specs, city and a link to the listing page. All listing text is in Polish. Prices are in PLN; for rentals, priceMin/priceMax filter the dai

tools.name: get_camper_details
tools.description: Get full details for one camper listing by slug (listing page id) or camper id (cam_...). With a slug, searches sale listings first, then rentals; set segment to force "sale" or "rental". With camper_id, returns the camper spec sheet from the full catalog. Includes decoded specs, photo URLs, equipme

tools.name: list_camper_makes
tools.description: List camper makes (brands) known to VanAuto with how many active sale and rental listings each has. Use this to resolve a brand name before searching.

tools.name: list_camper_equipment
tools.description: List the camper equipment catalog grouped by category. Equipment names are English identifiers used in listing filters and camper specs.

tools.name: get_camper_market_stats
tools.description: Current VanAuto market snapshot: active sale and rental listing counts, campers by body type, and makes with active inventory.

tools.name: analyze_camper_prices
tools.description: Market price statistics for a cohort of active sale listings: min, max, average, median, p25/p75 and counts, plus average price by production year. Optionally pass a listing slug (slug) to see how that listing compares to the cohort (percentile and deviation from median). Use this to answer "is this

tools.name: find_similar_campers
tools.description: Find sale listings similar to a given one (same market segment, price bracket and specs). Returns compact rows for the alternatives the platform suggests.

tools.name: get_rental_reviews
tools.description: Published customer reviews for a rental listing (id from search results, e.g. rls_...). Returns ratings and review text. Sale listings do not have reviews.

tools.name: search_marketplace_listings
tools.description: Search the VanAuto marketplace (akcesoria - camper parts and accessories). Supports text, manufacturer, category, condition, compatibility and price filters. Returns compact rows plus facets with category/condition counts.

tools.name: get_marketplace_listing_details
tools.description: Get full details for one marketplace (akcesoria) listing by slug: price, condition, shipping, compatibility, seller, photos and links. Optionally includes related offers and the seller's other listings.

tools.name: get_marketplace_seller
tools.description: Marketplace seller profile by id (from a marketplace listing's seller): display name, verification and trust badges, ratings and reputation, plus their active offers.

tools.name: search_wanted_ads
tools.description: Search marketplace wanted ads (kupię / poszukuję) posted by buyers looking for camper parts and accessories. Supports text, category and subcategory filters.
